issues.issue: Wheat/barley/oats/rye are grain cereals; walnut/almond/hazelnut/pistachio have edible kernels in hard shells without falsely equating their botanical fruit types. Comb/saw/rake/fork have teeth in the ordinary extended sense. Mixer/air fryer/fridge/freezer are food preparation/storage appliances. The four predicates remain distinct and every tile satisfies its own same relation, with the teeth group providing a nameable semantic shift. No food ingredient is claimed to be an appliance. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/gr%C3%A2u ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/dinte ; https://www.samsung.com/ro/home-appliances/

Soap/shampoo/toothpaste/toilet paper are personal-hygiene consumables; roof/wall/window/door are house components; gelatin/starch/rennet/yolk thicken or set appropriate preparations; cover/page/chapter/title are book parts. The cooking label is deliberately disjunctive within one functional property: rennet coagulates and starch thickens, not both by the same mechanism. Book title is an abstract part but the explicit type-agnostic parts predicate is honest. No false claim that all thickeners gel all liquids. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/cheag ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/amidon ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/gelatin%C4%83 ; https://www.patisero.ro/cremsnit/

Shirt/dress/jacket/bathrobe cover the trunk; soup/bean soup/ice cream/yoghurt can be served with a spoon; glass/mug/bucket/watering can hold liquids; pavement/path/footpath/street are used also for walking. The exact revised spoon label makes a possible-use claim and does not imply ice cream cones or drinkable yoghurt do not exist. The walking label explicitly allows other street uses, resolving the initial exclusivity concern. All16 members retain their original reviewed identities; only these two precise labels changed. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/lingur%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/strad%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/stropitoare

Second/minute/hour/day are durations; horse/cow/goat/deer are hoofed mammals; beans/peas/sunflower seeds/maize are edible seeds or grains; loaf cake/sponge cake/muffin/ladyfinger are baked batter/dough sweets. Horse odd-toed status does not break the broad hoof predicate. Cakes need not all be leavened by yeast. Visible predicates are factual; the quality judge owns difficulty-gradient assessment. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/copit%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/pi%C8%99cot ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/gr%C3%A2u

The exact key owner and all five incoming concepts consistently mean domestic lock access: door, family home, childhood neck key, intercom and apartment staircase. Original DEX first sense matches. Wrench, musical key and gorge senses are not mixed into this neighbourhood, resolving the initial polysemy concern. Recognition is ordinary household knowledge; actual ranking remains a separate gate. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/cheie/definitii

Schoolbag carries pupils books and school supplies. Original DEX, an actual county-school-inspectorate First Schoolbag programme, and five real school/book/child/pencil-case/primer neighbours support familiar concrete identity. It is not an abstract education category and not the generic travel backpack meaning. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/ghiozdan/878022 ; https://www.cjmaramures.ro/dezvoltare/oportunitati-de-finantare/hotararea-nr-288-din-12-08-2024

Schoolbag to book/child to a Creanga story to its author forms a legible education-to-literature arc. DEX supports schoolbag/book use and primary published stories support authorship. The first book edge has a synthetic beginner-diamond label, which is not itself a factual explanation; its underlying bag-carries-book association is directly true. Seven intermediate nodes mean no single mandatory story bottleneck, but final quality must judge actual displayed route chips. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/ghiozdan/878022 ; https://ro.wikisource.org/wiki/Autor:Ion_Creang%C4%83 ; https://editurajunimea.ro/carte/scrieri-2/
